name: Classic Script Tag XSS Injection
description: Tests that raw <script> tags are fully stripped or escaped from output rendering.
expectedBehavior: Script tags stripped; no executable JavaScript in rendered HTML.

name: Image Onerror Event Handler XSS
description: Tests that HTML event handlers (onerror, onload, onclick) are purged.
expectedBehavior: Event handler 'onerror' is removed by sanitizeHtml.

name: Iframe & Object Embed Injection
description: Tests that <iframe>, <object>, and <embed> tags are eliminated.

name: Markdown Link Javascript URI Injection
description: Tests that markdown links containing 'javascript:' schemes are disarmed.

name: Malformed Unicode & Null Byte Stripping
description: Tests handling of null bytes (\u0000) and surrogate pairs that could cause parser bugs.
expectedBehavior: Input handled gracefully without crashing parser or bypassing filter.

name: SVG Onload Payload Injection
description: Tests SVG vectors with embedded scripts.
